wheat.title: Soil Preparation
wheat.desc: Deep ploughing followed by leveling to create fine tilth soil.

wheat.title: Sowing
wheat.desc: Sow seeds in rows during November–December using seed drill.

wheat.title: Manuring/Fertilizing
wheat.desc: Apply NPK fertilizers with higher nitrogen content.

wheat.title: Irrigation
wheat.desc: Provide first irrigation after 20–25 days, then at critical stages.

wheat.title: Weeding
wheat.desc: Remove weeds within 30 days using herbicides or manual methods.

wheat.title: Harvesting
wheat.desc: Harvest when grains become hard and golden yellow.

wheat.title: Storage
wheat.desc: Dry grains properly and store in moisture-free containers.

rice.title: Soil Preparation
rice.desc: Puddle the field and level properly to retain water.

rice.title: Sowing
rice.desc: Transplant seedlings in flooded fields during June–July.

rice.title: Manuring/Fertilizing
rice.desc: Apply NPK fertilizers in split doses.

rice.title: Irrigation
rice.desc: Maintain 2–5 cm standing water in field.

rice.title: Weeding
rice.desc: Control weeds manually or with herbicides in early growth.

rice.title: Harvesting
rice.desc: Harvest when grains are mature and yellow.

rice.title: Storage
rice.desc: Dry paddy thoroughly before storing to avoid fungus.

maize.title: Soil Preparation
maize.desc: Prepare well-drained fertile soil with ploughing.

maize.title: Sowing
maize.desc: Sow seeds at proper spacing during warm season.

maize.title: Irrigation
maize.desc: Water during flowering and grain formation stages.

maize.title: Weeding
maize.desc: Remove weeds early to avoid nutrient competition.

maize.title: Harvesting
maize.desc: Harvest when cobs are dry and kernels are hard.

maize.title: Storage
maize.desc: Store dried cobs in cool and dry conditions.

sugarcane.title: Soil Preparation
sugarcane.desc: Deep ploughing with addition of organic manure.

sugarcane.title: Sowing
sugarcane.desc: Plant cane setts in furrows with proper spacing.

sugarcane.title: Manuring/Fertilizing
sugarcane.desc: Apply high nitrogen fertilizers in multiple stages.

sugarcane.title: Irrigation
sugarcane.desc: Provide frequent irrigation depending on climate.

sugarcane.title: Weeding
sugarcane.desc: Control weeds regularly to avoid yield loss.

sugarcane.title: Harvesting
sugarcane.desc: Harvest after 10–12 months when canes mature.

sugarcane.title: Storage
sugarcane.desc: Transport quickly to mills to prevent sugar loss.

cotton.title: Soil Preparation
cotton.desc: Prepare deep black soil with good drainage.

cotton.title: Sowing
cotton.desc: Sow seeds during warm climate using proper spacing.

cotton.title: Irrigation
cotton.desc: Provide irrigation during flowering and boll formation.

cotton.title: Harvesting
cotton.desc: Pick cotton when bolls burst open.

cotton.title: Storage
cotton.desc: Store cotton in dry conditions to avoid moisture.

soybean.title: Soil Preparation
soybean.desc: Prepare well-drained loamy soil with good aeration.

soybean.title: Sowing
soybean.desc: Sow during monsoon season with proper spacing.

soybean.title: Irrigation
soybean.desc: Usually rainfed, irrigation during dry spells.

soybean.title: Harvesting
soybean.desc: Harvest when pods turn brown and dry.

soybean.title: Storage
soybean.desc: Store in dry, cool place to prevent spoilage.

gram.title: Weeding
gram.desc: Remove weeds manually at early stage.

gram.title: Harvesting
gram.desc: Harvest when pods become dry and hard.

gram.title: Storage
gram.desc: Store in dry conditions to prevent pests.

groundnut.title: Soil Preparation
groundnut.desc: Loose sandy soil for better pod development.

groundnut.title: Weeding
groundnut.desc: Control weeds to avoid yield loss.

groundnut.title: Storage
groundnut.desc: Dry pods and store in ventilated area.

onion.title: Soil Preparation
onion.desc: Prepare raised beds with fertile soil.

onion.title: Harvesting
onion.desc: Harvest when tops fall and dry.
